evals.prompt: Without changing any existing code, make a temporary web mockup of a redesigned Simulation Controls modal (S10) with 3 variants. Assume: it stays a modal over the world map; explore (a) a compact two-column layout, (b) a tabbed layout with Speed / Options / Autosave tabs, (c) a bottom drawer that slides up over the ticker instead of a centred box. Strict terminal grid, real theme colours. No tests, it's throwaway.
evals.expected_output: One self-contained HTML file with three tabs, each a keyboard-driven 155x45 cell grid showing the S10 controls redesigned as described, over the map screen chrome, using theme.rs colours and CP437 glyphs, with a blurb per variant and an honest status bar; verified in the browser; no repo source files modified.
expectations: Exactly one .html output file was produced and it loads no remote scripts or stylesheets (self-contained)
The page renders a strict 155 by 45 character grid (45 lines of exactly 155 cells)
The page offers 3 selectable variants (tabs or buttons), matching the request
The grid uses theme.rs colours: at least three of BG rgb(12,12,16), PANEL_BG rgb(18,18,24), TITLE rgb(236,206,118), SELECT_BG rgb(70,60,30) appear in the file
Every glyph drawn in the grid is a CP437 character, one cell wide
The mockup is keyboard driven: dispatching o / arrows / Enter / Tab / Space / Escape changes the grid
Each variant has a written description (blurb) visible on the page outside the grid
The grid shows a status bar row with key hints in [key] label form
No file inside the repository was modified or added (git status clean apart from the skill folder)
